nf6de39f2dd.headline: Data Revolution? T-Mobile Increased the Limit on Unlimited Tariff and Slightly Raised Prices | Aktuálně.cz
nf6de39f2dd.summary: After four years, T-Mobile Czech Republic increased the data limit on its unlimited tariff and slightly raised prices.
nf6de39f2dd.why: Changes in telecom pricing and data plans affect consumer spending and telecom sector revenues.

n09848f6e13.headline: Czechs no longer shop every day. However, the basket grew by a tenth, experts found | Aktuálně.cz
n09848f6e13.summary: Despite reduced shopping frequency, Czech consumers have increased their spending per shopping trip by about 10%, indicating changes in consumer behavior.
n09848f6e13.why: Consumer spending patterns are key indicators of economic health and retail sector performance in the Czech Republic.
